quote.author: Michael Scotto
quote.text:
Update: After agreeing to a two-way deal with the Minnesota Timberwolves, Norchad Omier has changed his mind and plans to sign a two-way deal with the Cleveland Cavaliers, sources told HoopsHype.

The Timberwolves now have an open two-way spot after waiving Enrique Freeman.
